_notes: 18772: 'Da nobis auxilium de tribulatione' = Ps 59(Vulg):13 = 思高 Ps 60:13 '求你援助我们抵抗仇仇' — antiphon only cites first clause; rendered with sense of 'deliver us from tribulation' as the Vulgate reads. | 18777: 'Quaerite Dominum et vivet anima vestra' — probable source Ps 68:33(Vulg)=Ps 69:33(思高); 思高 v.33 reads '寻求天主的人，你们的心必要兴奋' (less literal than Vulg); rendered more literally per Vulgate sense, using Catholic register. | 18783: composite Advent antiphon (De Sion) — drawn from Is 35, Ex 15:2, Is 33:22 and parallel texts; not a single psalm, translated from Latin directly in Catholic register. | 18784/18789: Ps 50(Vulg)=51(思高) v.3: 思高 '天主，求你按照你的仁慈怜悯我，依你丰厚的慈爱，消灭我的罪恶' — antiphon picks only 'dele iniquitatem meam', rendered from 思高. | 18786: Ps 62(Vulg)=63(思高) v.2: 思高 '天主，你是我的天主，我急切寻觅你' — antiphon 'ad te de luce vigilo Deus' rendered from Vulgate meaning; 18787: liturgical antiphon formula, not precisely Ps 127; rendered directly. | 18793: Ps 134(Vulg)=135(思高) v.3 '请赞颂上主，因为上主是美善的'; second clause 'in servis suis deprecabitur' not in 思高 Ps 135:3 — rendered from Vulgate Latin. | 18798/18815: Ps 113B(Vulg):18=Ps 115:18(思高): '而是我们赞颂上主，从现今一直到永久'.
